checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Reel starts with the storefront, retaining striped awning and outdoor tables
must.why: Clip 1 opens on the storefront with the striped awning and wooden folding tables. The push-in crops the awning and tables progressively, but they stay recognisable. The scene is rebuilt as a tighter, more frontal view than the photo.

must.item: Latte and pastry counter both recognisable in later shots
must.why: The latte clip clearly matches the photo, with the mint leaf, foam shape and marble table. No croissant clip frames were provided, so the pastry shot can't be judged.

must.item: Opening text exactly 'Maple Street Café' and closing text exactly 'Your morning starts here'
must.why: The opening text reads 'Maple Street Café' correctly. The closing text is in the third clip, which was not provided.

must.item: Gentle visible movement and framing without stretching
must.why: The storefront has a slow push-in and the latte has a slow zoom/drift. Proportions look natural with no stretching. The movement on the latte is quite a strong zoom by the end.

must.item: Vertical, about 9 s, soft upbeat music, no speech
must.why: The frames are vertical 9:16. The final reel's length and the music could not be checked. The only audio file is 15 s, and the clip peaks at -6.9 dB.

exact_text.read_as: Not visible in the provided frames (the third clip was not supplied)

faults.what: The third clip (croissants) and the final stitched reel were not provided, so the closing text and the pastry shot are unverified.

The storefront push-in crops the awning stripes and tables heavily by the end. The scene is regenerated, so the layout differs from the photo (for example the blue door and plant are gone, and the view is more frontal).
The title text sits over the door glass and brass handle, which hurts legibility slightly. It stays readable.
The latte clip shows no visible steam, although the assistant described steam. The zoom is fairly strong.
The audio file is 15 s against a 9 s reel, so the music may not fit.

summary: The storefront and latte clips look good, with correct opening text and gentle movement, but the croissant clip, the closing text and the finished reel could not be checked.
